name: Mosman City Internet Services
summary: Sydney lower-north-shore dialup ISP (Mosman; bb.com.au / mosman.com / australians.com): PPP dialup from 14k4 to 33k6 plus ISDN, Sydney-only POPs, web design arm, upstream via Telstra Internet; IIA member. Listed in the Australian ISP List by Apr 1997 (BARROBAND PTY. LIMITED, ACN 003 614 202).

events.details: Listed in the Australian ISP List (Cynosure) by 10 Apr 1997 with Sydney-only POPs; own site bb.com.au live by 24 Dec 1997. Plans c. 1997: $20/mo for 15 hours ($1.50/hr extra) or $25/mo for 50MB; ph. (02) 9968 4505. Still listed with ISDN access in the Jan 2001 ISP List.

refs.label: Australian ISP List: Mosman City Internet Services (Wayback Oct 1999; entry last updated 27 Dec 1997)

events.details: Last successful Wayback capture of bb.com.au on 28 May 2002; no captures thereafter. The Mosman ISP identity left bb.com.au in 1999 (redirecting to NetPro by Oct 1999), earlier than both the current c.mid-2002 and the c.2000 proposal. redirected to NetPro.
